office: the Governorate of Vatican City State, which issues the ordinary passport centrally to Vatican citizens

routes.label: from the Governorate, in Vatican City

note: The Vatican's own sheet on its passports: the ordinary passport is for Vatican citizens only, issued centrally by the Governorate, valid for at most 5 years (the version issued from October 2020 had 50 pages). The Holy See's diplomatic, service and temporary service passports, issued by its Secretariat of State, aren't modelled. No fee and no processing time are published.

sources.said: Each entity issues its own passports. ... The Vatican City State has an electronic ordinary passport. ... VATICAN CITY STATE ORDINARY PASSPORT (version B valid until exp. date) ... C) 01 OCT 2020 – 17 DEC 2025 (polycarbonate) 50 pages, standard format ... Validity – 5 years (max) Nationality – Vatican citizens only ... Issuing – centralized, Governorate of Vatican City State
